purpose: Corrected BRK-B (Berkshire Hathaway Class B) diluted EPS in d3_eps_quarterly_pit.parquet.
defect: D3 as-filed EPS for ticker BRK-B carried Berkshire's reported EarningsPerShareDiluted/Basic value unconverted. Berkshire reports EPS on a Class-A-equivalent basis only (non-dimensional XBRL fact); the 1/1500 Class-B conversion ratio is disclosed only in a footnote (e.g. 10-Q filed 2013-11-01, accn 0001193125-13-423169: "Net earnings per Class B common share is equal to one-fifteen-hundredth (1/1,500) of such amount."), not as a separate structured fact, so it was not applied. Confirmed against the actual filed Statements of Earnings for BRK-B CIK 1067983 (e.g. Q3 2013: filed value ,074 for a 3-month period vs true BRK-B EPS ~.05). Root cause is systemic to BRK-B whenever ticker=BRK-B pulls the CIK-level EarningsPerShare* fact.
fix: eps_diluted_adj divided by 1500.0 for all rows where ticker=="BRK-B" (all quarters/vintages in the file, since the same unconverted-Class-A-equivalent value is used throughout the CIK's history). No other ticker or column changed.
how_to_apply: Left-join this file on (month_end,cik,q) [or just ticker==BRK-B] to replace eps_diluted_adj in d3_eps_quarterly_pit.parquet; recompute sue for BRK-B afterward (sue formula uses eps_diluted_adj).
not_fixed_here: BRK-A (if present under a separate ticker) should NOT be divided (its filed value IS the Class-A-equivalent already); this fix file only contains BRK-B rows.
